name: Shuzenji Reina
source:
A high-class young lady.
Possessing the dignity to be called a young lady, she is, without a doubt, an arrogant S-type character.
Although she is not a member of any bullying group, she does not directly bully the main character. She holds a grudge against Renji because of his rotten nature.

 “Am I saying something wrong?”
